anchorPolicy.floorMethod: preserve source lowest ankle/toe Y by rigid vertical translation after morph
anchorPolicy.seatMethod: preserve source pelvis Y unless that would force a foot through the source floor; never stretch a limb

contactBoundary.actorBoundProps: may follow morphed hand endpoints because that is morphology-space attachment preservation
contactBoundary.worldLockedContacts: must not be secretly re-aimed by Phase C; emit Phase-D retarget delta metadata
contactBoundary.handoff: morph each actor independently; shared prop may be placed at morphed wrist midpoint only for visualization/attachment preservation

diminutiveAdultRule: Retain adult head/body language, hand/foot maturity, shoulder/hip structure and torso maturity; compactness comes from stature and shorter lower limbs, not enlarged-child proportions.
childRule: Use larger head-to-height ratio, smaller hand/foot scale, shorter limbs and shorter torso relative to adult; never obtain child families by uniform scaling alone.
